cells.content:
## Executive Summary — Sprint 2 (V1.1)

- **Sprint health: amber.** The last two CI suite runs (*Sanity Test*) both passed 9 of 10 tests (90%), and the newest run was green — but across the full 30-day window only 23 of 39 executed tests passed (59%) and the sprint plan TP-2 stands at 8 passed / 1 failed of 9 executed.
- **Biggest risk #1 — shop filter/checkout path.** `ShopPage.applyProductFilters` times out on `selectOption` for `filter-category` (30s) in 4 consecutive runs each for the Maya Patel and Leo Grant checkout personas — this single page-object method accounts for the two highest failure counts in the project.
- **Biggest risk #2 — auth entry points.** The only open **critical** defect (D-2) is the Admin 2FA login (`getByTestId('username')` never visible), and the Manager login is blocked by the `promo-overlay` intercepting the Sign-in click. Both are on the login journey, so a release gate on authentication is not currently satisfied.
- **Coverage is the quiet gap.** 46% of cases are automated and only **1 of 32 critical-priority** cases has a script; requirement coverage is nevertheless 100% (20/20), so the risk is depth of verification, not traceability.
- **Recommended next steps.** (1) Stabilise `ShopPage.applyProductFilters` — wait for the filter panel before `selectOption`, or route filters via URL params. (2) Fix `promo-overlay` handling in `LoginPage.submitManagerCredentials` and assign D-2 to the auth owner. (3) Automate the 31 un-scripted critical cases before the V1.1 release gate, prioritising auth and checkout. (4) Re-baseline on the next full suite run so the trend stops being dominated by 1-test runs.
